entities.name: Sigmund Christoph von Waldburg zu Zeil und Trauchburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sigmund Christoph von Waldburg-Zeil-Trauchburg was a German Roman Catholic bishop. He was the last bishop of Chiemsee and apostolic administrator of Salzburg.
